Browsing for something specific? The [archive](blog-archive.qmd) lists every post by year.

Two runs are written to be read in order rather than dipped into. [Bias Correction](blog-series-bias-correction.qmd) is 30 posts over two and a half years, from why Indonesia is the hardest place on earth to measure rain through to the published paper and the thesis behind it. [El Niño 2026](blog-series-el-nino.qmd) is 10 posts and counting on the forecast event as it develops, and on why drought is what arrives minus what leaves.
